# Agents

## Overview

Four AI agent document types stored as JSON inside Mendix MPR files:

| Type | CREATE keyword | Notes |
|------|---------------|-------|
| Model | `create ai model` | GenAI model configuration; required by Agent |
| Knowledge Base | `create knowledge base` | KB source; referenced by Agent body |
| Consumed MCP Service | `create consumed mcp service` | MCP tool server; referenced by Agent body |
| Agent | `create agent` | Orchestrates model + tools + prompts |

**Requires:** Mendix 11.9+ and the full agent-editor marketplace stack (7 modules) —
`AgentEditorCommons` depends transitively on the other six, so all must be installed:

| Module | Role |
|--------|------|
| `GenAICommons` | Core AI types (Request/Response, DeployedModel, Tool, KnowledgeBase) |
| `MxGenAIConnector` | Mendix Cloud AI backend, model config, embeddings |
| `AgentCommons` | Agent management (versioned agents, tools, KBs, MCP) |
| `AgentEditorCommons` | Bridge to the Studio Pro Agent Editor extension |
| `MCPClient` | MCP server connections, tool discovery/execution |
| `ConversationalUI` | Chat widgets, tool-approval UI, trace monitoring |
| `Encryption` | Provides the 32-char key models/KBs reference |

Install them with `mxcli marketplace install <id> -p app.mpr` (or via Studio Pro). Also
register `ASU_AgentEditor` as an after-startup microflow.

## Syntax

### Model

```sql
mdl 1;
create ai model Module.MyModel (
  Provider: MxCloudGenAI,   -- default, can omit
  key: @Module.ApiKeyConst   -- must be a String constant
);
```

**`Provider` is free-form; `check` warns on a value Agent Editor rejects (MDL-AGENT01).**

| Document | Provider | Connector it imports through |
|---|---|---|
| AI model | `MxCloudGenAI` | MxGenAIConnector |
| AI model | `Azure` (Azure AI Foundry) | OpenAIConnector |
| AI model | `Fuse` (Agent Editor 2.7+) | FuseConnector |
| Knowledge base | `MxCloudGenAI` only | MxGenAIConnector |

MDL passes the value straight through, and mxbuild contains no agent-editor
strings, so `mx check` and the build stay green on a typo. The fault surfaces at
startup, when `ASU_AgentEditor` fails the import with "Model provider is not
one of the allowed types". `mxcli check` therefore warns, without a project, on
any other value or the wrong case. The values come from
`javasource/agenteditorcommons/actions/ImportDeployedModel.java`, whose
`getImportMicroflow` switch is the authority; read it in the app when a newer
Agent Editor may have added one. It warns rather than refuses for that reason.

### Knowledge Base

```sql
mdl 1;
create knowledge base Module.ProductDocs (
  Provider: MxCloudGenAI,
  key: @Module.KBKeyConst
);
```

### Consumed MCP Service

```sql
mdl 1;
create consumed mcp service Module.WebSearch (
  ProtocolVersion: v2025_03_26,
  version: '1.0',
  ConnectionTimeoutSeconds: 30,
  documentation: 'Web search MCP server'
);
```

### Published MCP Service

The other direction: the app publishes its microflows as an MCP server
(Agent Editor 2.6+, MCP Server 5.x). `./mxcli syntax agents.published-mcp-service`
has the full syntax; the `mcp-server` skill covers the contracts of the tool and
authentication microflows and the runtime-configured alternative.

```sql
mdl 1;
create published mcp service Module.CustomerMCP (
  EndpointPath: 'customers', Version: '1.0.0', ProtocolVersion: v2025_03_26
) {
  tool count_customers ( Microflow: Module.MCPTool_CountCustomers, Description: 'Count customers.' )
};
```

### Agent (full syntax)

```sql
mdl 1;
create agent Module.MyAgent (
  UsageType: task,              -- Task | Conversational
  model: Module.MyModel,        -- must exist
  description: 'Agent description',
  MaxTokens: 4096,
  Temperature: 0.7,             -- float
  TopP: 0.9,                    -- float
  ToolChoice: Auto,
  variables: ("Language": EntityAttribute, "Name": string),
  SystemPrompt: $$multi-line
prompt here.$$,
  UserPrompt: 'Single line prompt.'
)
{
  mcp service Module.WebSearch (
    Enabled: true
  )

  knowledge base KBAlias (
    source: Module.ProductDocs,
    collection: 'product-docs',
    MaxResults: 5,
    description: 'Product docs',
    Enabled: true
  )

  tool FetchCustomer (
    Document: Module.Tool_FetchCustomer,   -- the microflow the tool runs
    description: 'Fetch customer data',
    Enabled: true,
    UserAccessApproval: UserConfirmationRequired,  -- or HiddenForUser | VisibleForUser
    DisplayTitle: 'Look up customer'               -- shown to the user, not the model
  )
};
```

Human-in-the-loop and streaming (Agent Editor 2.2+): `UserAccessApproval` and
`DisplayTitle` / `DisplayDescription` on a `tool` or `mcp service` block;
`MinSimilarity` and `IsVisible` on a `knowledge base` block;
`EnableBackendStreaming` / `EnableUIStreaming` on the **agent**, not the model.
Streaming is not shown in Studio Pro's playground; it works at runtime with a
chat agent in Conversational UI. On `create or modify`, a setting left out keeps
its stored value.

## Altering existing documents

All four agent-editor document types support `ALTER` for targeted partial updates (no need to re-specify the whole document):

```sql
mdl 1;
-- Model, Knowledge Base, Consumed MCP Service: SET-only (no collections)
alter ai model Module.MyModel set DisplayName = 'GPT-4 Turbo', KeyName = 'OPENAI_KEY';

alter knowledge base Module.MyKB set ModelDisplayName = 'text-embedding-3-small';

alter consumed mcp service Module.MyMCP
    set ConnectionTimeoutSeconds = 60, Version = '0.2.0';

-- Agent: SET for scalars, ADD/DROP for tools, MCP services, knowledge bases
alter agent Module.MyAgent
    set SystemPrompt = 'New prompt', Temperature = 0.7, MaxTokens = 4096
    add tool MyTool ( Document: Module.MyMicroflow, Description: '...', Enabled: true )
    add mcp service Module.WeatherSvc ( Description: '...', Enabled: true )
    add knowledge base Docs ( Source: Module.MyKB, Collection: 'docs', MaxResults: 5 )
    drop tool OldTool
    drop mcp service Module.OldSvc
    drop knowledge base OldKB;
```

Property names match `CREATE` (`SystemPrompt`, `UserPrompt`, `Temperature`, `MaxTokens`, `ToolChoice`, `Model`, `Entity`, `Description`, `UsageType`, …). Unknown property names error out with `unknown agent property: X`. `CREATE OR MODIFY` remains available when you want a full replacement.

## Gotchas

### Dollar-quoting for multi-line prompts
Single-quoted strings cannot span lines. Use `$$...$$` for any SystemPrompt or UserPrompt that contains newlines. DESCRIBE always emits `$$...$$` when the value contains newlines, so DESCRIBE output re-parses cleanly.

### Portal-populated metadata fields
`DisplayName`, `KeyName`, `KeyID`, `Environment`, `ResourceName`, `DeepLinkURL` are populated by the Mendix portal at sync time. Do not set them manually in CREATE statements — they will be overwritten.

### documentId vs qualifiedName
Each document has both a `qualifiedName` (e.g. `Module.MyModel`) and an opaque `documentId` UUID. The UUID is assigned by ASU_AgentEditor at runtime. Only `qualifiedName` is set by CREATE; cross-reference lookups resolve by scanning all documents for a matching name.

### Drop order
Agents reference Model, Knowledge Base, and MCP Service documents. Always drop Agents before dropping their dependencies:
```sql
mdl 1;
drop agent Module.MyAgent;
drop consumed mcp service Module.WebSearch;
drop knowledge base Module.ProductDocs;
drop ai model Module.MyModel;
```

### Variables: syntax
- `"key": EntityAttribute` — binds an attribute from the entity in the agent's context
- `"key": string` — binds a plain string value
- Keys must be quoted (string literals or quoted identifiers)

### Association between BSON and MDL names
The feature uses `CustomBlobDocument` BSON type with a `Contents` field holding the JSON payload. The `$type` field is always `"AgentEditorCommons$CustomBlobDocument"`. The document type is identified by the `readableTypeName` inside `Metadata`.

## Common Patterns

### Minimal agent (no tools)
```sql
mdl 1;
create ai model Module.M (Provider: MxCloudGenAI, key: @Module.K);
create agent Module.A (
  UsageType: task,
  model: Module.M,
  SystemPrompt: 'You are a helpful assistant.',
  UserPrompt: 'Ask me anything.'
);
```

### Check all agent documents in a module
```sql
list ai models in module;
list knowledge bases in module;
list consumed mcp services in module;
list agents in module;
```

## Calling Agents from Microflows

Studio Pro's *Call Agent* and *New Chat for Agent* toolbox actions are **Java
actions exposed as microflow actions**, so `call java action` writes exactly the
activity the toolbox inserts. There is no separate `call agent` statement, and
none is needed (ako/mxcli#2024, measured on 11.16 projects).

For an agent made with `create agent` (an Agent Editor document), use the
**AgentEditorCommons** actions. They take the agent document by its qualified
name, in quotes, with no retrieve:

```sql
-- Task agent, no chat history. Pass a FileCollection to send a PDF or image.
$Response = call java action AgentEditorCommons.Agent_CallDocument_WithoutHistory(
  Agent = 'Module.MyAgent',
  OptionalContextObject = $Invoice,
  OptionalRequest = empty,
  OptionalFileCollection = empty
);

-- Chat agent, with history: the Request comes from the chat's preprocessing.
$Response = call java action AgentEditorCommons.Agent_CallDocument_WithHistory(
  Agent = 'Module.MyAgent',
  Request = $Request,
  OptionalContextObject = empty
);

-- A ChatContext wired to the agent, for Conversational UI.
$ChatContext = call java action AgentEditorCommons.ChatContext_Create_ForAgentDocument(
  Agent = 'Module.MyAgent',
  ActionMicroflow = 'Module.ChatContext_ActionMicroflow',
  ContextObject = $Customer,
  OverwritingDeployedModel = empty
);
```

`OptionalContextObject` / `ContextObject` fills the prompt's `{{variables}}` from
the object's attributes; its entity must be the agent's `Entity`.

The **AgentCommons** actions take an `AgentCommons.Agent` object instead of the
document: an agent built at runtime, or one `ASU_AgentEditor` imported from a
document. They have the same parameters: `Agent_Call_WithoutHistory(Agent, OptionalContextObject,
OptionalRequest, OptionalFileCollection)`,
`Agent_Call_WithHistory(Agent, Request, OptionalContextObject)` and
`ChatContext_Create_ForAgent(Agent, ActionMicroflow, ContextObject,
OverwritingDeployedModel)`.

```sql
-- _QualifiedName is the document's name, filled by ASU_AgentEditor; Title is not a stable key.
retrieve $Agent from AgentCommons.Agent
  where _QualifiedName = 'Module.MyAgent'
  first;
$Response = call java action AgentCommons.Agent_Call_WithoutHistory(
  Agent = $Agent, OptionalContextObject = $Invoice,
  OptionalRequest = empty, OptionalFileCollection = empty
);
```

**A document reference is checked, a runtime retrieve is not.** `check
--references` resolves `Agent = 'Module.MyAgent'`, so a script that calls an
agent by document passes only once that agent exists. When a tool microflow
calls a flow that calls the agent that uses the tool, no statement order works
on a fresh project: break the cycle with the AgentCommons form and a retrieve
by `_QualifiedName`, which is what `Agent_CallDocument_*` does internally.

## AI agent documents

Model, Knowledge Base, Consumed MCP Service, Agent (LIST/DESCRIBE/CREATE/DROP, with variables, tools, KB tools, dollar-quoted multi-line prompts; requires AgentEditorCommons module, Mendix 11.9+)
